knownLimitations: Official landing family totals and child-category totals disagree by 6 in Seamaster; site-wide aggregation reconciliation remains NOT PASS.
Formal update covers all 552 existing JP market refs; it does not claim 552 is Omega JP sitewide total.

Candidate review: 13 refs absent from the 2026-09-19 full capture appear in 2026-10-08 JP categories, but remain outside formal market/history pending reference-specific PDP/status evidence; 210.83 case/strap text conflicts, and JP imageUrl/dial-color evidence is missing.

210.83.42.20.01.001 and 210.83.42.20.03.001 have conflicting material text between category rawText and card CTA; caseDescription is null pending clarification. Dial descriptions remain null for all 13 because the reviewed JP cards do not state dial colors.

The 13 additions are not yet present in the shared catalog; catalog merge remains coordinator-owned and awaits official imageUrl/dialColors evidence. README still lists the previous JP Omega count of 552 and needs coordinator synchronization.

Twelve refs absent from the 2026-09-19 capture remain present in the complete 2026-10-08 JP category observations but are category-only candidates, not formal market/history rows, pending reference-specific JP PDP price and CTA/status verification.

Only 210.30.42.20.03.004 of the 13 candidates is formally represented in the market and run 2 history; its PDP supports retailer-only at JPY 1,287,000. Category card prices/CTAs for the other 12 remain evidence-only.

The 210.83 material text conflict remains unresolved in category evidence; no 210.83 candidate is formally represented in the market pending PDP clarification. Dial descriptions and official image URLs remain unavailable for the candidates.
The current market has 553 refs: 547 match current category cards and 6 are individually checked PDP-discontinued refs; 12 category refs remain outside the formal market pending PDP evidence.
protectedScope: Only Omega JP market/history/evidence files are in scope.
